## Claude Code

Commands and skills are also registered natively, generated from the `.agents/` sources:
- `.claude/commands/` — one entry per `.agents/commands/*.md`, invoke directly with `/name`.
- `.claude/skills/` — one entry per `.agents/skills/*/SKILL.md`, `user-invocable: false` so Claude loads them autonomously by description match, never as a typed `/name`.

Both are generated by [`.agents/hooks/sync-claude-native.sh`](.agents/hooks/sync-claude-native.sh). Never hand-edit files under `.claude/commands/`, `.claude/skills/`, or this file — edit the `.agents/` source and rerun the script.
